shortTitle: Principles and Practice of Sleep Medicine
fullTitle: Principles and Practice of Sleep Medicine
libraryStatus: Exact 7th-edition title/copyright identity is content-verified from the Guild Drive source. The Drive connector now provides searchable text from the oversized 349 MB source, allowing printed chapter-page locators to be verified without guessing.
locatorStatus: Section structure verified; twenty-five high-value RPSGT-relevant printed chapter start pages are directly verified from the searchable Guild Drive source. The locator set intentionally favors core physiology, clinical assessment, respiratory/PAP/NIV, and methodology rather than attempting a cover-to-cover 213-chapter index.
apaCitation: Kryger, M. H., Roth, T., & Goldstein, C. A. (Eds.). (2022). Principles and practice of sleep medicine (7th ed.). Elsevier.
bestFor: Comprehensive sleep-medicine foundations, physiology, chronobiology, pharmacology, diagnostic reasoning, insomnia, hypersomnolence, parasomnias, sleep-disordered breathing, cardiovascular/medical comorbidity, pediatric-to-adult transitions, therapy context, and testing methodology.
authorityBoundary: Comprehensive textbook study support only. Current AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 controls scoring and technical rules; ICSD-3-TR controls diagnostic classification; current AASM/AAST guidance, physician orders, facility policy, and manufacturer instructions govern current testing, treatment, and technologist-practice requirements when they differ from textbook material.
versionSensitiveLocatorBoundary: Chapters 124, 125, 134, and 140 provide CSA/advanced-therapy study context, but the 2025 AASM central sleep apnea treatment guideline controls current treatment recommendations.
Chapters 131 and 132 support adult OSA evaluation and PAP concepts, but current AASM scoring, diagnostic-testing, PAP-treatment, and manual-titration guidance controls rule-sensitive content.

Chapters 138 and 140 support hypoventilation/NIV concepts; device- or mode-specific settings and execution require current professional guidance plus physician order, facility policy, and manufacturer instructions.
Chapters 197, 198, 199, and 200 support scoring/monitoring understanding, but the current AASM Scoring Manual Version 3 controls actual scoring and technical rules.
copyrightUse: Use bibliographic metadata, verified section/chapter titles, original Sleep Pathways Guild summaries, and chapter/page routing only. Do not reproduce textbook prose, figures, tables, algorithms, cases, questions, or substantial protected passages.
